name: DIE OR SWING
source:
When I woke up, a beautiful blue sky spread out to fill my view.
The back of my head hurts. There I realized that I had collapsed in front of the front door.
What were you doing? Get ready for the morning as usual and open the door to go to school ...
For some reason, I have no memory after that. But that's right. I was about to go to school.
If nothing is done, it will be late. I grabbed the bag that had fallen beside me and slowly got up and started walking.
As we approach school, familiar sounds begin to reverberate.
It is the sound of a metal bat hitting a ball in the morning training of the baseball club. I should be familiar with it.
It was terribly scary.

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27847]Freem![/url]]
translation:
当我醒来时，美丽的蓝天铺满了我的视野。
我的后脑勺很痛。在那里我意识到我已经倒在前门前了。
你在做什么？像往常一样做好早晨的准备，打开门去上学……
出于某种原因，在那之后我就没有任何记忆了。但那是对的。我正要去上学。
如果什么都不做，那就晚了。我抓起落在身边的包，慢慢地站起来，开始往前走。
当我们接近学校时，熟悉的声音开始回响。
这是棒球部早训时金属球棒击球的声音。我应该很熟悉。
太可怕了。
